_about: What each job description in uploads/01_new_role actually says, as the New Role step 2 shows it. It is not in the merged db.

findings.text: Confirms all 6 of your areas: classification, exposure, routing, economics, the watch and submissions.
findings.quote: “Characterises new waste streams, finds the unit in the network that can take them, prices them on full cost and keeps every accepted stream with an outlet.”

findings.text: Add a task to Route in the network: confirm the slot with the plant manager before a re-route is booked.
findings.quote: “Confirms the receiving slot with the plant manager before transport is booked for a re-routed shipment.”
findings.value: Confirm the slot with the plant manager before a re-route is booked

findings.text: Take the laboratory part of Characterise and classify out of scope. The Riverbend laboratory releases results; the analyst reads them.
findings.quote: “Analytical results are released by the Laboratory Manager; the analyst reads released results and never approves on a preliminary one.”

findings.text: Set the threshold on Contract margin: a quote under 28% on full cost needs the Pricing and Margin Manager's exception.
findings.quote: §4.2 “No contract is quoted below 28% margin on full cost without a written exception from the Pricing and Margin Manager.”

findings.text: Add a routine: a weekly outlet call with Third-Party Approvals for the eight weeks before an approval expires.
findings.quote: “For the eight weeks before a third-party approval expires, joins the weekly outlet call with the Third-Party Approvals Lead.”

routine.name: Outlet approval call
routine.cadence: Weekly, eight weeks before an approval expires
routine.output: Approvals list with the move for each stream

findings.text: Add Linda Choi to the people it works for. The description says permit conditions are read with Compliance.
findings.quote: “Reads permit conditions and feed limits with the Compliance Manager before a routing is approved.”
“Checks receipts against permits, keeps the transfer clocks and tracks renewals.”

findings.text: Add a task to Permit compliance: reconcile the chlorine feed log with the manifests each week.
findings.quote: “Reconciles the kiln chlorine feed log with the manifests received each week.”
findings.value: Reconcile the chlorine feed log with the manifests weekly

findings.quote: “Keeps the price book, reviews quotes and re-prices on fee and cost changes.”

findings.text: Add a task to Price book: keep the transport rate card current with Transportation before each review.
findings.quote: “Keeps the lane rate card current with the Transportation Manager.”
findings.value: Keep the lane rate card current

findings.quote: “Plans trucks and slots, keeps the service centers inside the transfer limit and maintains the lane rate card.”

findings.text: Add a task to Service centers: plan consolidation loads from the pad every Tuesday and Friday.
findings.quote: “Plans consolidation loads from each service center twice a week.”
findings.value: Plan consolidation loads twice a week
